firm_data.firm_description: Morrin & Sands Attorneys at Law represents clients with disabilities and injury victims, focusing on Social Security Disability and New York Workers’ Compensation.
notable_facts: The firm's founder, Daniel M. Morrin, has more than 30 years of legal experience.
The firm offers free case reviews.

email.subject: AI for Morrin & Sands, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Daniel,

With over 30 years in practice, you know the pressure: Social Security Disability and Workers' Compensation cases demand precision, but they also demand speed. Most firms your size are still managing case documents and client communications the way they did a decade ago.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in your region to meet firms like Morrin & Sands. I'd be happy to stop by Bellmore to show how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete without sacrificing quality.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
